answer.sourceLine: Wikiquote prints this passage in its sourced section for The Nasty Bits(2006). The original edition’s page and publication history of the individual essay were not independently established.

author.heading: About Anthony Bourdain
author.bio: Bourdain worked as executive chef at Manhattan’s Brasserie Les Halles before becoming a widely read food writer. His television series, including No Reservations and Parts Unknown, explored food alongside culture and everyday life.

context.heading: The setting behind the words
lead: The passage’s continuation says travel can leave painful as well as beautiful marks. That qualification matters because the excerpt is often read as straightforward encouragement to travel. The collection’s mixture of food writing and travel reflection supplies a broader setting than a standalone slogan. Wikiquote passage and continuation ↗
